intro: The Shining Strand is the strip of shoreline hugging Lordamere Lake along eastern Silverpine Forest, stretching south from the Ruins of Lordaeron toward the rugged foothills of Alterac. Its shallows are home to settlements of aggressive Vile Fin murlocs, making the lakeshore dangerous ground for unseasoned travelers.

p: Running along the eastern edge of Silverpine Forest, the Shining Strand borders the misty waters of Lordamere Lake. The Vile Fin tribe of murlocs has established several aggressive settlements along these shallows, posing a deadly hazard to anyone attempting to travel the lake road, while feral worgen roam the deep woods of Silverpine behind the shore.
